In  CRIMINAL REVISION APPLICATION NO. 305 of 2015 ==========================================================
 JESINGBHAI KHIMABHAI SUMAD....Applicant(s)
 Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT & 1....Respondent(s)
==========================================================
Appearance:
MR DK MODI, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1 Ms.Hansa Punani, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ==========================================================

CORAM: HONOURABLE MS JUSTICE SONIA GOKANI  Date : 29/06/2015  COMMON ORAL ORDER Learned Second Additional Senior Civil Judge and Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Surendranagar in Criminal Case No. 603 of 2003 vide judgment and order dated 18th February,
2012 convicted the accused-applicant herein for the offence punishable under Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and directed him to undergo the sentence of simple imprisonment for the period of three months and R/CR.RA/305/2015 ORDER to pay a fine of Rs.500/- and in default one month simple imprisonment.

sentences.text: 1 Mr. D.K.Modi, learned advocate appearing for the applicant-convict has urged that the sample collected was of 'separated milk' and standard applied by the Court are of 'skimmed milk'.
No standards according to him are prescribed for 'separated milk'.
Therefore, conviction is based on the prescribed standard which are meant for some other commodity.
He therefore, urged that the judgment and order impugned is illegal and dehors the provisions of law.

According to him,
laboratory report indicates the use of "Garbad" method which is held to be imperfect for the sample of milk.
As could be noticed that the person is aged about 73 years. He was on bail all throughout when the proceedings continued before the trial Court and the Appellate Court.
R/CR.RA/305/2015 ORDER
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, so also the evidence on record, oral as well as documentary, the present Criminal Revision Application deserves to be admitted Hence, RULE.

Pending hearing and final disposal of the present Criminal Revision Application, sentence awarded by the learned Second Additional Senior Civil Judge and Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Surendranagar in Criminal Case No. 603 of 2003 vide judgment and order dated 18th February,
2012 and confirmed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Surendranagar in Criminal Appeal No. 21 of 2012 vide judgment and order dated 16th June, 2015 is hereby suspended and the applicant-convict is ordered to be enlarged on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court.
He shall not leave the territory of India, except prior permission of this Court.
The applicant-convict shall deposit his passport, if any with the Registry of this Court.
The applicant shall furnish fresh address to the police authority.

R/CR.RA/305/2015 ORDER The Record and Proceedings (R&P) be called for, so as to reach this Court on or before 17th July, 2015.
Direct service is permitted.
(MS SONIA GOKANI, J.) BINA Jesingbhai Khimabhai Sumad vs State Of Gujarat & on 29 June, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105288875/
